summary: Tested country flags on /subsidiaries, CMS add/edit/tier-change/delete company flow, and locked-asset DELETE protection. Core flow works end-to-end. Fixed 2 small bugs during testing: (1) UAE flag fell back to globe icon because country text is 'United Arab Emirates (UAE)'; (2) CMS slot labels/order were wrong for new companies (TIER_RANK '?? 1' made subsidiaries rank equal to affiliates, giving 'Subsidiaries 10' and placing new cards after affiliates). Found 1 open bug: card text fields lose data when edited in quick succession (stale meta closure).

ui_bugs.issue: Data loss race: each field's onBlur saves {...asset.meta, [field]} using the meta snapshot from the last render. If the user edits several fields before refresh() comes back, later saves overwrite earlier ones. Reproduced: filled name/city/country/tag/sector ~1.5s apart; 'tag' was missing from DB meta afterwards.

issues: Flags with white halves (Indonesia, Singapore) blend into the cream background and look like half circles. Add a thin ring/border (e.g. ring-1 ring-black/10) to span.country-flag
Card subline shows a dangling 'SINGAPORE ·' when role is empty (Subsidiaries.jsx line ~171 always adds ' · ' when the city contains a comma)
With 8 subsidiaries the last row has an empty gap (accepted per request)

action_items: Fix the SubCardTextForm stale-meta race: keep a useRef holding the latest meta, update it right away on every save, and send PUTs based on that ref (or merge meta on the server side).
Optional: add a ring around the round flags so white parts stay visible on the light background.
Optional: only add the ' · ' separator when both country and role exist.
Minor: Home.jsx sorts subCards twice. The second sort (by sort_order) overrides the affiliate-last sort, so affiliate-last only holds by accident of sort_order values.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin.jsx is 1142 lines. Split it into modules, e.g. the Images tab and the user management code.
buildCompanies prefers static def.name/tag/role/sector over CMS meta for the 9 seeded companies. Public text uses t('subsidiary.id.*') overrides, so it works, but the data flow is confusing.
Real company cards are now deletable (in_use false). This is intended, and a confirm dialog is shown.
updated_files: /app/frontend/src/components/CountryFlag.jsx (countryCode now strips parenthetical text and tries the inner text, so 'United Arab Emirates (UAE)' gives 'ae')
/app/frontend/src/pages/Admin.jsx (TIER_RANK fallback changed from ?? 1 to ?? 0 in slotLabel and the group sort)

success_rate.frontend: 90% (all flows pass after fixes; 1 open data-loss bug)

seed_data_creation: Created test company co_mvo8921y plus one pytest asset co_qa*. Both were deleted. Verified home_subsidiaries again holds exactly sac, sae, sti, agi, ecs, sm, tsn, san, kgi.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: flags flag-us, flag-ae (after fix), flag-id, flag-cn, flag-sg; add-company upload creates a co_* card with Jenis defaulting to subsidiary and label 'Subsidiaries 8' (after fix); public card and summary item appear; clicking the summary item scrolls to the card; Jenis=Affiliate moves the card to affiliate-grid / affiliates-list ('Affiliate 3'); Home shows 6 cards; Del with confirm removes the card in CMS and on the public page; DELETE of cover/logo returns 409. Retest the meta race fix by filling several fields quickly and then checking /api/assets meta.
